# `PromptGetInterceptorInterface`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Interceptor\PromptGetInterceptorInterface`

**Interface** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/Interceptor/PromptGetInterceptorInterface.php)

Public extension point wrapping every prompts/get — attribute prompts and
configurator-registered ones (e.g. MarkdownPromptsConfigurator) alike.
Implementations run in configured order (first = outermost) and decide
whether to call $next: auditing, tracing, ACL.

Throw \Mcp\Exception\PromptGetException to reject the call with a
client-visible message; any other exception becomes an opaque internal
error. To pretend the prompt does not exist, throw
\Mcp\Exception\PromptNotFoundException.

## Methods

### intercept()

```php
intercept(Interceptor\PromptGetContext $context, callable $next): mixed
```
